pages.text: $(l)bigreactors-control$() runs $(item)Extreme Reactors$() reactors and turbines: connect their computer ports with an $(item)Adapter$() or cable and run it. Use $(l)-s$() to run silently.$(br2)Install: $(l)oppm install bigreactors-control$()

$(l)energy-monitor$() graphs a Draconic Evolution $(item)Energy Core$() on a screen (see /usr/share/doc/energy-monitor for setup).$(br2)Install: $(l)oppm install energy-monitor$()$(br2)$(l)charts$() is a library for your own bars and graphs.$(br2)Install: $(l)oppm install charts$()
